source.paper: Luecken and Theis, Molecular Systems Biology (2019)

learning.priority: Reproduce chart topology, encodings, hierarchy, threshold placement, inset geometry and legend position after inspecting the published figure and author code.
learning.independent_implementation: The BioFigure renderer was written independently in R/ggplot2 and patchwork; it does not translate or execute the author's Python plotting cells.
learning.data_role: Public counts provide realistic plotting values. Exact numeric or pixel identity is outside this case's acceptance target.
learning.layout_rules: A and B are distributions; A contains an upper-right low-count inset. C is a descending barcode-rank curve with log y. D is a counts-versus-genes scatter; its continuous mitochondrial-fraction colourbar remains outside the right edge and may not overlap data.
learning.failure_modes: Reject missing inset, linear rank y-axis, swapped threshold orientation, panel-letter drift caused by inset tagging, discrete treatment of mitochondrial fraction, or colourbar overlap.

validation.numerical_fidelity: not used as the completion criterion
